leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a Node.js Express server with a checkout endpoint
Configure middleware to parse JSON request bodies
Initialize an in-memory store for idempotency key tracking
Implement idempotency key validation logic in request handlers
Apply conditional logic to prevent duplicate checkout processing
Manipulate response data to include idempotency key status
Integrate error handling for missing or invalid idempotency keys
lessonTitle: Build checkout API with idempotency keys
